text: Horrific injustices. Mircea Vulcă says, "You need to know. You need. You long for God to be a God of justice because if He's not, then you're tempted to take the sword up yourself. The only way that you won't express anger in an unrighteous way is if you believe that God one day is going to settle the score, that God one day is going to make everything right and new. " So, how do you address your anger?
